format.note: Double round-robin, 38 matches, one table, no split. Season runs November-May.

conflicts.topic: Our row says 18, the league now has 20
conflicts.detail: 2024-25 was an 18-club season (18-team table, two relegated). The league expanded to 20 for 2025-26 and the league's own infobox and format section now describe 20 clubs and 38 games. Our row is one season stale.

The 2026-27 season has started (November 2026) but has no Wikipedia article, so the 2026-27 size of 20 is inferred from the league page describing the current (2025-26) season as 20 clubs. It is not confirmed by a 2026-27 club list.

conflicts.topic: Single row, so closed both ways
conflicts.detail: Three clubs are relegated to the Ethiopian Higher League each season, but that league is not in our data, so the report marks the downward direction closed.

notes: Season 2026-27 (November 2026 - May 2027). The league is a plain 20-club double round-robin (38 matches), three relegated. Our row's level is right; its size (18) is one season out of date. No split, no play-offs, no reserve-team complications. Cups and CAF competitions excluded.
